semantic.justification: Original ZipPackageBuffer lazy byte Sequence, end/current/capacity bookkeeping, doubling based on end plus input, shared input/output cursor, no-op close/flush, bounded read/skip/seek and generated exception Context/argument contracts. Actual UNO query and Sequence copy-on-write, native ZipOutputStream/ZipFile write/read integration are covered. JS backing memory remains GC-managed. Physical allocations/OOM, signed32 capacity overflow and native ABI are unqualified; package storage, compression, document model/filter/UI integration remains unfinished.
